About this prototype

The existing website is preserved. The provider app has been simplified. Each keeps its own local records; they do not synchronise. Assistant drafts need your review. Live accounts, messaging, tracking and payments are not connected.

Built-in help works without a model key. Connected AI requires the optional localhost server. Voice depends on your browser and may need an internet connection.
